sql: MERGE INTO s2.bench.events t USING src_stage3_S5_P0_mid_s11_r540_health_avro_20261116_cdc_merge_0004 s ON t.event_id = s.event_id AND t.dt = s.dt AND t.key = s.key AND ((system.bucket(8, t.key) = 0 AND t.dt = DATE '2026-11-25') OR (system.bucket(8, t.key) = 2 AND t.dt = DATE '2026-11-30') OR (system.bucket(8, t.key) = 5 AND t.dt = DATE '2026-11-30')) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET amount = s.amount, status = s.status, version = t.version + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
